title: A flowing liquid phase induces the crystallization processes of cesium lead triiodide for 21.85%-efficiency solar cells and low-energy loss
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04051A, Paper
Fei Yang, Yuyao Ruan, Shuo Li, Xingpei Wei, Shuwan Zai, Fei Gao, Shengzhong (Frank) Liu, Wangen Zhao
The PCE of AFMS passivated CsPbI3 PSCs reached 21.85%, which is the highest for this type of pure cesium lead triiodide solar cell.
